definitions.explanation: The complete thing considered as a unit.
Used adverbially to mean 'in general' or 'overall'.

examples.japanese: {全体|ぜんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：03571_handan⟧⟦べき→べき：10016_beki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: You should judge by looking at the whole picture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧{全体|ぜんたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: The whole company will work on it together.

examples.japanese: {全体|ぜんたい}⟦{的|てき}→的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Overall, it was a good result.

examples.english: It's a problem for society as a whole.

notes:
{全体|ぜんたい} refers to the entirety of something viewed as a single unit. It can function as a noun or as an adverbial modifier.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全体|ぜんたい} (the entire plan)
- Suffix: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧{全体|ぜんたい} (the whole company), ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧{全体|ぜんたい} (society as a whole)
- Adverbial: {全体|ぜんたい}⟦{的|てき}→的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (overall, generally), {全体|ぜんたい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (on the whole)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体|ぜんたい}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧: overall picture
- {全体|ぜんたい}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: general meeting
- {全体|ぜんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：05625_haaku⟧: to grasp the whole

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all, everything (focuses on totality of individual items)
- {全体|ぜんたい}: the whole (focuses on the unified entity)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{一体|いったい}→一体：01731_ittai⟧{全体|ぜんたい} — emphatic in questions: "just what/who/why on earth..."
